notes.title: Price Update Implemented
notes.content:
Hello again after a long time, I mentioned that the price of alpha & beta will be $1 in my last announcement, even though it has been a while since this announcement, I made the price update, I thought it would be more logical to apply the price update after the discount periods, so the implementation of the new price policy was a bit was late.

I said I would do the DLC for free as well, and I did it right after the announcement. I have to admit, it was a mistake from the very beginning to publish this DLC for a fee, and you are absolutely right in your reactions. I promise you that in my new games, I will not install paid DLC unless it offers really great content.

Let's talk a little bit about my new game, I'm planning to release a demo in April, but because the team members are a bit busy, we can't progress at the speed I want, which probably means the demo will be delayed. I prefer to delay instead of releasing a bad or incomplete demo. The planned release date of the game is the first quarter of 2024, but I cannot say that it will definitely be released on this date at the moment. However, I can say that I believe this game will be a really good game and I am doing my best to present you a good game. I can say that it will be a much more advanced game than Alpha & beta. When I release the demo, I will announce it here. That's all I'm going to say for today, see you when the demo is released.

notes.title: v1.1.0b Update Released
notes.content:
Hello again after a long time, actually I had no intention of updating to alpha & beta but I posted a small update as I needed to fix an error that was detected and reported to me two days ago. There are many platforms where you can contact me to fix the errors you have detected. The change made:

- Fixed the issue where some thorns did not close and the thorns would go into a weird animation.

In the meantime, let me talk a little about the innovations that I wanted to bring to alpha & beta but could not. I noticed that playing Alpha & beta at 30 fps made it feel like the game was low performance and I wanted to bring 60 fps support, but the game got strangely two times faster. Also i wanted to add nice details such as double bouncing, being thrown, screen shaking when hitting the ground, but I wanted to add these features before. I couldn't add them because I didn't create a proper infrastructure, luckily my new game will have all of these

How about the new game? Tell us a little bit about it?

My new game is still in development, but I am not very interested as I am very busy, but I plan to share a playable demo on itch.io and gamejolt in January 2021. Of course, I set the target release year as 2023. If everything goes well, I plan to release it at the beginning of 2023. My new game will be a metroidvania - rpg mix platform game and you will be able to play the game at 60fps :D also most features without alpha & beta will be available. Some players have said that alpha & beta is extremely difficult, I plan to have many people tested in order to fine-tune the difficulty of the new game. That's all for now, when I release a demo that can be played on itch.io and gamejolt platforms, I'll share it here, stay waiting.

notes.title: About 1st April Update
notes.content: I came to you with bad news today, with the April 1 update, I was thinking of adding items that make the game beautiful, such as double jumping, dashing, and screenshake when hit on the ground, but due to some technical problems, i couldn't add it but there will be much more in the game I just developed. I will make a small update based on your feedback, you will be able to see how many bullet you have left without going to the stop screen.

notes.title: Bug Fix Update
notes.content:
As I promised, even though I interrupted the development of the game, we continue to make corrections updates for detected bugs, and we've also made minor improvements. The changes that have been made:

- Fixed issue where players who choose a difficulty level different from normal go to normal map after finishing 1st world

- When the camera disappears, it fixing when you press the "p" key twice ("start" if you are using a gamepad), don't worry, it's a rare occurrence. We hope to resolve this error soon

- We've refreshed the menu's background and now looks more aesthetic, and when you buy and activate the DLC, it will open with a darker background.

notes.title: v.1.0.6 Update is Available
notes.content:
Hi everyone, in this update, we have made mainly updates to the gameplay, limiting the projectile to offer a more strategic gameplay, but we did not leave you desperate, now you can kill crush some of your enemies, but the most important point of this update was definitely the addition of control support, we support both directinput and xinput connections, you can also use d-pad and analog

- Added controller support

- Added a button to read all the patch notes to the main menu with one click

- Help button removed from main menu

- Now you can kill some enemies by crushing

- Bullet limitation added

- An icon that controls the status of the control connection to the main menu and stop menu is added, A green icon indicates that the controller is connected The red icon indicates that the controller is not connected

notes.title: v.1.0.4 Update is About
notes.content: Hi everyone, I want to break my long silence and give news from the new update. I will not mention the update in detail, but I will summarize the update with outlines. First of all, we completely renew the background of the game, the new backgrounds are both eye-catching and meticulously prepared to put you in a better atmosphere. I take your feedback into account, and as a result we have changed the way of telling the story. I were aware that reading long texts was boring, and i had some ideas for this, we decided not to wait any longer to make the change. We also had a more beautiful news for you, this beautiful news would be to add the german language, but because of some disputes with the translator we decided to include the german language in the next update, I hope that the next update in the German language players and the German language to play the next game We can get together. In the meantime I heard that you liked the story of the game very much and I am very glad that you like it, and I hope you will love our new storytelling model and wait for our news.
